faqs.a:
It shall be unlawful for any person to enter into or trespass upon any enclosed areas
               of a park, including, but not limited to, fenced swimming pools, tennis courts and
               buildings whenever such facilities are closed to the public by locked gates, doors
               or barricades or where any enclosed area of a park is posted with a sign restricting
               the use of said facility.
(Code 1960, § 17-29; Code 1981, § 22-8)
State Law reference—
Criminal trespass, C.R.S. § 18-4-502 et seq.
